summary.text: Don L. Ipson is a Republican member of the Utah Senate representing District 29 in Washington County and has served since January 2009. His official legislative profile lists his profession as businessman.

paragraphs.text: Ipson graduated from Panguitch High School and has a degree in accounting and business administration from LDS Business College.
His affiliations include past president of the Southern Utah Trucking Association and the Utah Trucking Association, and past chair of the Utah College of Applied Technology.
He sits on the Senate Business and Labor Committee, the Senate Rules Committee, and the Senate Transportation, Public Utilities, Energy, and Technology Committee.
